title: Mexican Tomato Chicken Soup with Chilli and Crispy Tortilla Strips
summary: A bright, dairy-free Mexican-inspired chicken soup with a tomato-rich broth, gentle chilli heat and crunchy baked tortilla strips. It makes a satisfying lunch with tender shredded chicken, sweetcorn and black beans.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the corn tortillas into thin strips, toss them on a baking tray with 1 tbsp olive oil and a pinch of the salt, then bake for 8–10 minutes until crisp and lightly golden. Set aside.
Heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the onion and red bell pepper and cook for 6–8 minutes until softened and starting to colour.
Add the garlic, chilli, cumin, paprika and dried oregano. Cook for 1 minute, stirring, until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste, then add the canned tomatoes, chicken stock, remaining salt and black pepper. Bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken breasts, reduce the heat to a gentle simmer and cook for 18–22 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and no longer pink in the centre.

Lift the chicken onto a board and shred it with two forks. Return it to the pan with the black beans and sweetcorn, then simmer for 5 minutes until everything is hot and the soup is slightly thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Ladle into bowls, squeeze over lime juice, scatter with fresh coriander and top with the crispy tortilla strips just before serving.
